meta.title: Custom wallpaper
meta.description: Custom background wallpaper for the Harness Web UI. Settings → General → Custom wallpaper lets you pick from the built-in image library or an image URL and adjust fit, focus, opacity, scrim, blur with a live preview and presets; a full form is also available under Settings → Plugins. Values live in the official settings document, survive restarts, and apply immediately. Library images are served same-origin; only custom URLs make network requests.
